page: Microsoft Azure M32pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on 64-bit ARM processor architecture and managed under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 512 GB of total system RAM, establishing an expansive memory-to-compute ratio of 16 GB per core. This architecture provides steady, non-burstable compute resources designed to prevent noisy-neighbor contention in enterprise environments that require deterministic execution.

The physical configuration bundles 1,888 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed scratch space, temporary indexing, and high-IOPS staging capacity directly on the host hypervisor. The server does not incorporate hardware GPU accelerators, directing all platform resources toward memory and storage performance. A notable architectural consideration is its arm64 instruction set, which necessitates compatible operating systems and software binaries, foregoing standard x86 vector extensions such as AVX-512 while taking advantage of ARM power and execution efficiencies.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the ARM-based M32pds_v4 delivers substantial memory density per core, offering an economical compute footprint for applications whose resource bottlenecks are governed by memory capacity rather than raw compute cycles. With its combination of dedicated processor cores, half a terabyte of RAM, and integrated NVMe storage, this server is suitable for hosting large in-memory databases, distributed key-value stores like Redis, analytical caching layers, and high-throughput data transformation pipelines.
description: The Microsoft Azure M32pds_v4 is an arm64 memory-optimized virtual machine engineered for demanding memory-centric workloads. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside an extensive 512 GB system memory pool, delivering a high allocation of 16 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration bundles 1,888 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency staging and temporary file processing, while excluding GPU accelerators. By utilizing ARM processor architecture, this instance provides high resource density and operational cost efficiency for workloads prioritizing memory footprints over pure compute cycles. With its generous memory capacity, dedicated cores, and fast local NVMe disk, the M32pds_v4 fits large in-memory databases, distributed caching clusters, analytical data warehousing, and memory-intensive ETL operations.
